links.outcome: Multimodal LLM chest radiograph diagnostic accuracy against reference diagnoses
links.effect: Overall accuracy was 28% at baseline and 62% with structured context; lung cancer 20%, feeding tube placement 40%, rib fractures not identified in either condition; overall reliability inadequate for independent clinical use.
links.quote: Structured contextual guidance improved performance on selected chest radiograph tasks, but overall diagnostic reliability remained inadequate for independent clinical use.

unlisted_practices: Providing structured contextual teaching module and radiologic framework prompting to improve multimodal LLM chest radiograph interpretation

screen.practice: structured context prompting with teaching module and radiologic framework
screen.reason: Empirically tests whether providing a structured contextual intervention (radiologic framework and few-shot/teaching module context) improves the diagnostic accuracy of a multimodal LLM on chest radiographs compared to a baseline prompt.

primary.practice: structured context and reporting prompt guidance
